declared.title: Credentials rotate and revoke atomically; queued writes are rechecked before any byte, and no socket keeps authority

stdout.text: <ready and report lines are parsed, not stored: the ready line carries the bearer>

cases.summary: Through the bridge: the writer's send to the sequenced terminal is admitted with a queued receipt within 1000 ms while the holder write boundary is held and zero PTY bytes exist; releasing it writes 2 bytes reported already_committed with the holder's delivery facts. Multiline text with submit none is refused as paste_refused (no bracketed paste) and a control sequence as invalid_encoding, both before admission. The owner rotates the writer's credential c3 at principal epoch 1: one step issues c4 and withdraws c3 at credential epoch 2 and principal epoch 2, and the writer's still-queued write is reported cancelled_before_commit (credential_revoked); releasing the boundary then writes nothing. The writer's open socket is refused credential_revoked at principal epoch 2, reconnecting with the old bearer fails hello, the kept replacement bearer reconnects, inspects its principal's earlier operation, sends again and is delivered; it may not rotate itself (forbidden) and a rotation naming stale principal epoch 1 is version_conflict at epoch 2.

stdout.text: <ready and report lines are parsed, not stored: the ready line carries the bearer>

cases.summary: An open prompt p1 version 1 and a queued write of the writer exist; the owner revokes c3, which reports the write cancelled_before_commit at principal epoch 2. prompt.answer over the revoked writer socket, with the plan's numeric version literal or a valid decimal one, is refused credential_revoked at principal epoch 2 before its parameters are decoded; p1 stays open at version 1 with no answer, the released boundary writes nothing and the PTY holds zero bytes. Revoking again advances both the credential and principal epoch to 3; an unknown credential is not_found; reconnecting with the revoked bearer fails hello.
